name: Descript
description: Descript is a video editor you can direct through conversation. Describe what you want — clean up a podcast episode, pull highlight clips from an interview or translate a video into Spanish. Descript handles the end-to-end production: transcribing, removing filler words, cleaning up background noise, adding captions, adding visuals and more.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Descript to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Descript to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.descript.com/v2/mcp/claude. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is Descript MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 16, 2026, Descript scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Descript MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Descript provides these MCP tools: import_media, prompt_project_agent, get_job, list_jobs, and cancel_job.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Descript?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Descript in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
Descript requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Why is Descript failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Descript scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is MCP negotiation succeeds (v1/v2). Failed to connect: Authentication required Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Descript is developed by Descript. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
